Translation.Upload-Post Setup Guide:
Antes de ativar a publicação automática:
1. Crie uma chave API em [API Keys]({api_keys_url}).
2. Crie ou selecione um usuário de publicação em [Manage Users]({manage_users_url}) e conecte as plataformas de destino.

Informe abaixo o **nome de usuário** de publicação, não o e-mail da sua conta Upload-Post.

Translation.chatgpt.oauth.revocation_unconfirmed: Sessão terminada localmente. A revogação remota não foi confirmada; consulte as aplicações ligadas no ChatGPT.
Translation.chatgpt.oauth.busy: Outro processo está atualizando a sessão do ChatGPT. Tente novamente em breve.
Translation.chatgpt.oauth.ineligible: O plano do ChatGPT não está disponível para esta conta ou espaço. Escolha outro provedor explicitamente.
Translation.chatgpt.oauth.preview_import: Não há credenciais de prévia OAuth nativa para importar ou o destino já existe.
Translation.chatgpt.oauth.eligibility: OAuth nativo exige conta ou espaço elegível e navegador no mesmo computador que Python. Login remoto/Docker não é suportado. Codex continua disponível separadamente.
Translation.codex.image.label: Imagens OpenAI - Codex
Translation.codex.image.help: Usa a sessão compartilhada do ChatGPT e os limites da conta. Escolha um modelo Responses independente do LLM. O catálogo não garante acesso a imagens.
Translation.codex.oauth.shared: Uma conta ChatGPT atende texto e imagens. Desconectar afeta ambos.
Translation.codex.image.model_required: Escolha um modelo Responses Codex para imagens.
Translation.codex.image.invalid_timeout: O tempo limite deve ser um número positivo e finito.
Translation.codex.image.invalid_result: Codex não retornou uma única imagem completa e válida.
Translation.codex.image.uncertain: A solicitação pode ter sido processada. Geração interrompida sem repetir.
Translation.codex.image.save_failed: Não foi possível salvar a imagem Codex. Interrompido sem repetir.
Translation.codex.image.render_failed: Não foi possível renderizar a imagem Codex. Interrompido sem repetir.
Translation.General Providers Help: Escolha um provedor configurado e clique em Usar. Gerencie as credenciais nas configurações dele.
Translation.Provider Configuration Changed: A configuração mudou. Revise as configurações deste provedor.
Translation.Step 1 Tip:
#### Step 1 tips

- **Video Subject**: the product name and its selling points, e.g. *Soft facial tissues, 10 packs, $5*.
- Open **Advanced Script Settings** to pick a sales script template.
- Generate the script with AI, then check the price and offer.
Translation.Step 2 Tip:
#### Step 2 tips

- **Video Source**: choose **Local file** and drop in product photos or clips (jpg, png, webp, mp4).
- **Source Frame Fit**: **Fit with Blurred Background** keeps the whole photo.
- **Image Motion**: **Static** keeps the product sharp.
- Mix in a few real clips: short-video platforms favour real footage over slideshows.
Translation.Step 3 Tip:
#### Step 3 tips

- Pick a voiceover service and voice that match the script language.
- Preview the voice before generating the video.
Translation.Step 4 Tip:
#### Step 4 tips

- Pick a font that supports the script language.
- **Bottom** is the easiest position to read on a phone.
- Then click **Generate Video** at the bottom of the page.
Translation.Sales Overlay Help: Leave a field empty to hide it.
Translation.CTA Text Help: Shown during the last 3.5 seconds of the video.
Translation.Sales Overlay Default CTA: Tap the cart to buy now
Translation.Affiliate Link Help: Your short affiliate link. It is added to the post text.
Translation.Generate Post Caption Help: After the video is made, AI writes a caption and adds the price, link and hashtags. Saved as dang-bai.txt next to the video.
Translation.Post Caption Copy Help: Use the copy icon in the corner of the box, then paste it when you post the video.
Translation.Hook Text Help: One hook per line. When a run makes several videos, video 1 uses line 1, video 2 uses line 2, and so on.
Translation.Hook Variants Caption: {count} hooks. Set the number of videos per run in step ② to get {count} different versions.
Translation.Hooks Need Subject: Enter the video subject (product name) before generating hooks.
Translation.Hooks Generation Failed: AI could not generate hooks. Please try again in a moment.
Translation.Product Batch Settings: Batch videos from an Excel file
Translation.Product Batch Help: One row per product: name, price, original price, hook, affiliate link and the folder with its photos. Every other setting (voice, subtitles, music) comes from this form. Videos are made one after another.
Translation.Product Batch Submitted: Queued {count} product videos. They are made one at a time; follow them in the task manager.
Translation.Product Batch Needs TTS: Batch videos need an AI voice. Switch the voiceover away from an uploaded audio file.
Translation.Gentle Zoom No Crop: Gentle zoom, never crops (best for product photos)
Translation.Shopee Preset Help: Sets 9:16, full photos on a blurred background with a gentle zoom, real clips first, a short script, the VieNeu voice (when configured), big word-by-word subtitles and quiet background music. Your text, prices and uploaded files are kept.
Translation.Shopee Preset Applied: Standard Shopee video settings applied. Check each step, then press Generate Video.
Translation.Real Clip First: Start the video with a filmed clip
Translation.Real Clip First Help: When you upload both photos and phone clips, a filmed clip plays first. Shopee and TikTok often reject videos made only of still photos.
Translation.Channel Name Help: A small tag shown in the top corner for the whole video, e.g. @reviewnhacua. Leave empty to hide it.
Translation.Step 5 Tip:
**Keep a steady pace**

Tick **Posted** under each finished video after you upload it. Shopee unlocks product tagging for accounts that post regularly (about 5 videos in 30 days).

Download the commission report from Shopee Affiliate and drop it here to see which products and videos earn. Put a different Sub_ID in each video's link to compare videos.
Translation.Mark As Posted Help: Tick after you upload this video to Shopee, TikTok or Facebook, to count it in the 30-day posting pace.
Translation.Posting Pace Remaining: Post {remaining} more video(s) within 30 days to reach the target.
Translation.Posting Pace Gap: Your last post was {days} days ago. Post a new video to keep the pace.
Translation.Posting Pace Empty: No videos marked as posted yet.
Translation.Commission Report Help: In Shopee Affiliate, open the commission report, export it as CSV or Excel and upload it here. The file stays on this computer.
Translation.Commission Sub ID Hint: Tip: add a different Sub_ID to each video's affiliate link to see which video sells.
Translation.Category Home CTA: Tap the cart, it makes life easier
Translation.Category Beauty CTA: Tap the cart to try it now
Translation.Category Food CTA: Tap the cart to order before it sells out
Translation.Category Fashion CTA: Tap the cart to pick your size
Translation.Category Tech CTA: Tap the cart to see the best price
Translation.Sub ID Help: The Sub_ID you entered when making this video's affiliate link in Shopee Affiliate. The Tracking step uses it to tell which video and which opening line sold.
Translation.Winning Hooks Saved: Saved. They now appear in step 1 under the opening line.
Translation.Cover Image Help: Use it as the video cover when posting: a frame of the product with a big title and the price.
Translation.Smart Trim: Skip blurry or dark parts of filmed clips
Translation.Smart Trim Help: Each filmed clip is cut into short parts; parts that are much blurrier (shaky) than the rest of the clip, or almost black, are left out.
Translation.Remove Background Help: Cuts the product out of its photo and puts it on a clean light background with a soft shadow. Runs offline; the first run downloads a small model.
Translation.Remove Background Not Installed: Needs the free rembg add-on. Ask to have it installed, or run: pip install "rembg[cpu]" in the app environment.
Translation.Before After Help: Upload a before and an after photo to open the video with a side-by-side comparison. Good for cleaning, beauty and storage products.
Translation.Posting Schedule Help: Finished videos that are not posted yet get one day each, starting today. Change a date if you like, and tick Posted after uploading.
Translation.Posting Schedule Empty: No finished videos waiting to be posted.
Translation.App Backup Help: Saves the posting log, schedule, winning opening lines and your settings in one .zip file (no API keys). Upload that file on another computer to restore.
